calls.reason: SHIELD-RT reduced acute-care visits with extra care for AI-selected patients, and MASAI improved screening. Neither settles AI's effect on cancer's broader human toll; CDC death counts do not isolate that effect.

BEN-2293 and rentosertib showed acceptable trial tolerability. These examples neither establish nor rule out repeated animal-to-human safety failures, and the packet does not establish their claimed biological cause.
CDC mortality data document cancer's continuing burden, but do not establish which advances are necessary to beat it. The packet contains no decisive achievement testing this open-ended forecast.
